description: Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition + DLC (native Linux, Beamdog GOG v2.6.6.0p)
long: Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition is a remaster of BioWare's acclaimed 2000 Dungeons & Dragons role-playing game on the Infinity Engine. Players continue the saga of the Bhaalspawn through the city of Athkatla and beyond, with deep party-based real-time-with-pause AD&D combat and rich companion stories. This edition bundles the Throne of Bhaal expansion plus new content from Beamdog.
